event_summary: A light lavender rectangular block moves and turns across the top of a black circular object while nearby objects remain visually stationary.
raw_event_description: The scene shows a wooden tabletop with a black circular device on the right, a small angled reflective object on the left, a purple strip hanging from the angled object, and a black cable extending from the circular device. A light lavender rectangular block is initially on the front area of the black circular top. Over time, the block changes position and orientation across the circular top, moving toward the left/front edge, then around the upper portion of the top, and later toward the upper-right area. The black circular object, angled reflective object, purple hanging strip, cable, tabletop, and wall do not show visible displacement or shape change.

reasons: The light lavender rectangular block is already visible on the black circular top in the first frame.
The black circular object, reflective angled object, purple strip, cable, tabletop, and wall are visible.
No separate start trigger or pre-event interval is shown.
